p: Among those who were appointed to sing the psalms and to play on instruments, one was appointed chief to set the tune, and to begin: who had the charge because he was most excellent and he began this psalm on the instrument called Neginoth or in a tune so called.
O God of my righteousness: You who are the defender of my just cause.
distress: Both of mind and body.
sons of men: You who think yourselves noble in this world.
love vanity: Though your enterprises please you, yet God will bring them to nothing.
godly for himself: A king who walks in his vocation.
Stand in awe: For fear of God's judgment.
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness: Serve God purely, and not with outward ceremonies.
good: The multitude seeks worldly wealth, but David sets his happiness in God's favour.

only makest me dwell in safety: This word in Hebrew may be referred to God, as it is here translated, or to David, signifying that he should dwell as joyfully alone, as if he had many about him, because the Lord is with him.
